questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Runs' in the 18/19 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 542.

questions.question: Who topped the wickets charts in the 13/14 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Cara le Roux led with 9 wickets.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Heat?
At which ground did Bronwyn Sumption record their career-best bowling figures (2-27, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: "Tuskers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: KwaZulu-Natal Inland was rebranded Tuskers (KwaZulu-Natal Coastal became the Dolphins).

questions.question: At which ground did Kei record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 174, against Heat on 2018/02/10.
